' REQ: LANG-1931 LANG-1932 LANG-1933 LANG-1934
/' Block comment '/
Type Greeter
    Name As String
End Type
Function Greet(ByVal g As Greeter, ByVal times As Integer) As String
    Dim text As String = "Hello, " & g.Name & "! ""quoted"""
    For i As Integer = 1 To times
        Print text
    Next
    Return text
End Function
Dim g As Greeter : g.Name = "fb"
If Len(Greet(g, 2)) > 0 And True Then Print &H1F
